location: Nauvis - New Dawn - Tar Processing Sector
summary: Today was mostly spent trying to understand and set up tar processing. The system is far more complex than I initially expected, with multiple branching fluid chains that all need to be handled carefully.
I began by setting up the first stage of tar processing, converting tar and steam into Middle Oil, Creosote, Anthracene Oil, and Pitch.
From there, I established the next stage of processing by converting Middle Oil and steam into Light Oil, Carbolic Oil, and Naphthalene Oil.
I connected the Carbolic Oil output to the stone miners, which should begin improving passive stone production.
However, the rest of the fluid outputs are not yet fully processed or utilized. Each byproduct requires its own handling chain, and the overall system is proving to be quite complicated.
Managing all these outputs will require additional infrastructure and careful balancing to avoid backups or wasted resources.
Aside from tar processing, I also completed the remaining modules for the forestry sector.
With that, the wood production system is now fully operational at full capacity, providing a strong and stable supply of wood for fuel and processing.
On the research side, I continued focusing on quality-of-life upgrades.
I completed Basic Inventory Size 1, Basic Crafting Speed 1, and Basic Mining Speed 1.
These upgrades improve overall efficiency by allowing me to carry more materials, craft faster, and gather resources more quickly when manual intervention is required.
